scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF 3D peer screen across structural readers, raw carriers, explicit-geometry projection, ACIS inspection, and native application consumption; refine existing plan gates only.

method.kind: Primary project documentation, source, and project issue reports reviewed through public project pages
limitations: Mutable master documentation/source is not a version-pinned runtime result.
FreeCAD and ACadSharp issue reports are scoped observations and were not independently reproduced.
A parser, renderer, carrier inspector, projection, and geometry kernel answer different questions and are not interchangeable evidence.

evidence.observation: The project's known-issues page lists MESH and MPOLYGON as unsupported and describes 3DFACE as a polygon representation with writer caveats.
evidence.planUse: Admit exact entity/direction comparisons only; count unsupported, omitted, flattened, triangulated, and repaired records explicitly.

evidence.observation: The CAD route is read-only, documents a narrow POINT/LINE/CIRCLE/ARC/3DFACE projection, and is based on libopencad. GDAL's separate ODA DWG route requires non-public ODA libraries.
evidence.planUse: Do not treat the CAD driver as an ACIS/AcDs or full DWG object-graph oracle; keep libopencad and ODA as distinct implementation and licensing routes.

evidence.route: FreeCAD DXF importer and ACIS consumer
evidence.observation: A maintainer response distinguishes explicit entities that import from proprietary ACIS blobs that the FOSS path cannot read. Documentation distinguishes C++ and legacy Python importers; source-level shape construction alone does not prove runtime acceptance.
evidence.planUse: Use FreeCAD as a pinned explicit-face consumer profile unless an exact installed backend independently demonstrates ACIS acceptance; capture importer mode, build, warnings, object type, and expected geometry.

evidence.observation: The drawing add-on does not render ACIS and projects 3D entities into XY; browse-acis inspects/exports SAT/SAB bytes; required ACIS authoring data is provided by an external library.
evidence.planUse: Separate raw carrier inspection, explicit geometry rendering, authoring, and kernel semantics; do not count the viewer as a solid-shape oracle.

evidence.observation: LibreDWG's own README discloses advanced R2010+ read omissions, later writer limitations, and no 3D handling in its SVG output. ACadSharp issue #1195 reports DWG-read solids omitted by its DXF writer; the report is version-scoped and unreproduced in this review.
evidence.planUse: Bind claims to exact version, direction, entity family, and emitted representation; reader release notes, aggregate version coverage, or successful open do not establish writer or 3D parity.

existingGatesRefined: S8 downstream consumer and publication evidence
peerAdmissionRequirements: Name the route role: structural parser, raw-carrier inspector, carrier writer, explicit-geometry projector, ACIS parser, geometry kernel, or native application.
Pin artifact/source, version/build options, platform, importer/exporter settings, and source/output hashes at composed checkpoints.
Record shared parser, kernel, and control-author lineage; do not count related tools as independent votes.
Compare explicit DXF families separately and count unsupported, omitted, flattened, triangulated, or repaired output.
Keep modeler entity identity, SAT/SAB or AcDs carrier and ownership closure, geometric projection, closed B-rep validity, and native application acceptance as distinct axes.
planDelta.fastValidationPolicy: Generated local tests remain the normal per-slice gate. Run an eligible external peer/native route only at an existing composed checkpoint; unavailable tools are NOT_RUN and do not block local implementation.
